sentinels.derived: computed from other quantities in this project
sentinels.measured_here: measured by this project from deposited coordinates
sentinels.method_choice: an algorithmic choice, not a measured quantity
sentinels.convention: a community convention rather than a measurement
sentinels.unverified: value in use but its source could not be confirmed

parameters.name: IP3 on-rate a1
parameters.description: Binding rate of IP3 to its site on one subunit.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: Inhibitory Ca2+ on-rate a2
parameters.description: Binding rate of Ca2+ to the slow inhibitory site; sets the time scale of inactivation (Li-Rinzel h gate).
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: Activating Ca2+ on-rate a5
parameters.description: Binding rate of Ca2+ to the fast activating site.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: IP3 dissociation constant d1
parameters.description: IP3 site affinity when the inhibitory site is empty.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: Inhibitory Ca2+ dissociation constant d2
parameters.description: Inhibitory-site affinity with IP3 bound.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: IP3 dissociation constant d3
parameters.description: IP3 site affinity when the inhibitory site is occupied.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: Activating Ca2+ dissociation constant d5
parameters.description: Activating-site affinity.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: Active subunits to open
parameters.description: A channel conducts when this many of its four subunits are in the active state. The deterministic Li-Rinzel flux uses the cube of the subunit activity, i.e. three.
parameters.source_note: Li & Rinzel 1994 (the cubic exponent); Shuai & Jung 2002 use the same 3-of-4 rule for single stochastic channels

parameters.name: Maximal open probability P_max
parameters.description: Plateau P_open; unchanged by IP3.
parameters.source_note: Mak, McBride & Foskett 1998, Eqs. 1-2 and text; Xenopus oocyte nuclear IP3R-1, verified against the PMC28128 text 2026-09-24

parameters.name: Activating Ca2+ half-constant K_act
parameters.description: Unchanged by IP3.
parameters.source_note: Mak, McBride & Foskett 1998, Eqs. 1-2 and text; Xenopus oocyte nuclear IP3R-1, verified against the PMC28128 text 2026-09-24 (210 +/- 20 nM)

parameters.name: Activation Hill coefficient H_act
parameters.description: Unchanged by IP3.
parameters.source_note: Mak, McBride & Foskett 1998, Eqs. 1-2 and text; Xenopus oocyte nuclear IP3R-1, verified against the PMC28128 text 2026-09-24 (1.9 +/- 0.3)

parameters.name: Inhibition Hill coefficient H_inh
parameters.description: Unchanged by IP3.
parameters.source_note: Mak, McBride & Foskett 1998, Eqs. 1-2 and text; Xenopus oocyte nuclear IP3R-1, verified against the PMC28128 text 2026-09-24 (3.9 +/- 0.7)

parameters.name: K_inh at saturating IP3, K_inf
parameters.description: Ceiling of the IP3-tuned inhibition constant (Eq. 2).
parameters.source_note: Mak, McBride & Foskett 1998, Eqs. 1-2 and text; Xenopus oocyte nuclear IP3R-1, verified against the PMC28128 text 2026-09-24 (52 +/- 4 uM; the 10 uM IP3 fit alone gave 54)

parameters.name: IP3 half-constant of K_inh, K_IP3
parameters.description: IP3 at which K_inh is half its ceiling (Eq. 2).
parameters.source_note: Mak, McBride & Foskett 1998, Eqs. 1-2 and text; Xenopus oocyte nuclear IP3R-1, verified against the PMC28128 text 2026-09-24 (50 +/- 4 nM)

parameters.name: Hill coefficient of K_inh in IP3, H_IP3
parameters.description: Steepness of the IP3 tuning (Eq. 2).
parameters.source_note: Mak, McBride & Foskett 1998, Eqs. 1-2 and text; Xenopus oocyte nuclear IP3R-1, verified against the PMC28128 text 2026-09-24 (4 +/- 0.5)

parameters.name: Low end of the flank comparison
parameters.description: Both gating models' flanks are compared from this IP3 to the high end.
parameters.source_note: The lowest IP3 at which Mak et al. state Ca2+ activation was not affected (33 nM); below it their bell collapses

parameters.name: High end of the flank comparison
parameters.description: Saturating IP3 for the flank comparison.
parameters.source_note: The saturating IP3 of Mak et al.'s Fig. 1c fit

parameters.name: Maximal channel flux rate v1
parameters.description: Rate constant of IP3R-mediated release.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: ER leak rate v2
parameters.description: Passive leak from the ER.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: SERCA maximal rate v3
parameters.description: Maximal SERCA uptake.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: SERCA half-activation k3
parameters.description: Ca2+ at half-maximal SERCA uptake (Hill 2).
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: Total cell Ca2+ c0
parameters.description: Total free Ca2+ referred to the cytosolic volume; conserved in the closed-cell model.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: ER/cytosol volume ratio c1
parameters.description: Ratio of ER to cytosolic volume.
parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: Channels per cluster
parameters.description: Number of IP3Rs in the simulated cluster.
parameters.source_note: Order-of-magnitude choice: Smith & Parker 2009 resolve puffs made of a few to a few tens of channel openings; the cluster modelled here is a teaching default, not a measurement

parameters.name: Resting cytosolic Ca2+
parameters.description: Background Ca2+ each channel sees when no channel in the cluster is open.
parameters.source_note: The customary 100 nM resting level; the same value is the lower bound of the Li-Rinzel oscillation in its own figures

parameters.name: Cluster Ca2+ per open channel
parameters.description: Mean-field increment of the Ca2+ every channel in the cluster sees for each open channel — the coupling that turns a blip into a puff.
parameters.source_note: A mean-field simplification of Swillens et al. 1999, who show that puffs need inter-channel Ca2+ coupling; 1 uM per channel was chosen from a scan (0-2 uM at 0.05-0.2 uM IP3) as the value that most raises the Fano factor of simultaneous openings. The local nanodomain at an open pore is far higher and is not modelled

parameters.name: Puff simulation time step
parameters.description: Fixed step of the stochastic gate simulation.
parameters.source_note: Chosen so the fastest transition probability per step (a1 x IP3 or a5 x cluster Ca2+) stays below about 0.1 at the default parameters

parameters.name: ANM contact cutoff
parameters.description: C-alpha pairs closer than this are joined by a spring.
parameters.source_note: Atilgan et al. 2001 use 13-15 A; the upper end keeps a coarse-grained tetramer connected

parameters.name: ANM spring constant
parameters.description: Uniform stiffness scale; only eigenvalue ratios are reported.
parameters.source_note: Eigenvalues are arbitrary without a B-factor fit

parameters.name: ANM distance scale d0
parameters.description: Distance scale of the inverse-square spring weighting.
parameters.source_note: Yang et al. 2009 parameter-free ANM weighting

parameters.name: Modes computed
parameters.description: Non-trivial normal modes kept.
parameters.source_note: Enough to cover the collective motions; more only costs time

parameters.name: C-alpha stride
parameters.description: Keep every n-th C-alpha of each subunit.
parameters.source_note: A full tetramer is ~9,000 C-alphas; a stride of 3 keeps the shift-invert solve interactive while the low modes, which are collective by construction, are insensitive to it

parameters.name: C4 character tolerance
parameters.description: How close to an ideal character (+1, -1, 0) a mode must be to receive an irrep label.
parameters.source_note: Coarse-grained deposits are not perfectly symmetric; beyond this the mode is reported as mixed rather than forced into a label

parameters.name: Collective-mode threshold
parameters.description: Modes whose collectivity (Bruschweiler's kappa, the fraction of sites effectively moving) is below this are reported as local network artefacts, not collective motions.
parameters.source_note: The measure is Bruschweiler 1995; the threshold is ours. On the 8TKG network at strides 1-5 every mode is either <= 0.11 (weakly attached fragments, near-zero eigenvalues) or >= 0.27; 0.2 sits in that gap. At stride 4 the 'lowest A mode' was such a fragment (kappa 0.01, overlap 0.008) while the collective one below it had 0.49

parameters.name: Minimum common residues
parameters.description: Fewer residues common to both deposits than this and no transition is built.
parameters.source_note: A sanity floor, not a tuning knob: two deposits of one paralog share thousands (8TKG/8TKF: 2,198 per subunit); fewer than 50 means the wrong pair or the wrong numbering

parameters.name: Subunit correspondence tie
parameters.description: Cyclic subunit correspondences whose fit RMSD is within this of the best are treated as equally good; the tie goes to the deposited chain labels.
parameters.source_note: A C4-symmetric pair fits every cyclic relabelling to within ~0.01 A (8TKG->8TKF: 14.18 A for all four); 0.05 A is above that and far below any real mismatch

parameters.name: Morph frames
parameters.description: Solved frames between the two endpoints.
parameters.source_note: As the PIEZO1 simulator: smooth playback; more only costs time

parameters.name: Morph restraint iterations
parameters.description: SHAKE-style passes restoring peptide C-alpha-C-alpha distances per frame.
parameters.source_note: As the PIEZO1 simulator; the reported bond error shows whether it was enough

parameters.name: Peptide bond cut
parameters.description: Consecutive basis C-alphas farther apart than this in either endpoint are a chain break, not a bond, and are not restrained.
parameters.source_note: A trans peptide C-alpha-C-alpha distance is 3.8 A; 6 A admits coordinate error and excludes any gap of one missing residue or more

parameters.name: Displacement colour scale top
parameters.description: Per-residue displacement at which the fixed displacement ramp saturates.
parameters.source_note: Fixed, never auto-ranged, so two transitions painted with it can be compared; 8TKG->8TKF fitted on the pore domain has a 95th percentile of 24.1 A and a maximum of 30.6 A, so only the most mobile few per cent of the cytosolic assembly saturate

parameters.name: Pore profile step
parameters.description: Axial sampling interval of the pore profile.
parameters.source_note: The value ip3r_genes S0 used, so the two profiles share a grid

parameters.name: Pore profile half-slab
parameters.description: Half-thickness of the slab in which the minimum heavy-atom distance to the axis is taken.
parameters.source_note: The value ip3r_genes S0 used for structure_pore.tsv

parameters.name: Lining-residue half-slab
parameters.description: Half-thickness of the slab searched for the residues forming a constriction.
parameters.source_note: As ip3r_genes S0

parameters.name: Lining-residue radial tolerance
parameters.description: Atoms within this distance of the minimum radius count as lining the constriction.
parameters.source_note: As ip3r_genes S0

parameters.name: Ligand contact cutoff
parameters.description: Heavy-atom distance at which a residue counts as an IP3 contact.
parameters.source_note: The cutoff ip3r_genes S0 and S22 used for the ten measured contacts

parameters.name: Module coverage floor
parameters.description: Fraction of a module's reference columns an orthologue must resolve for its identity to enter the paired core-vs-pore test.
parameters.source_note: S22's MIN_MODULE_COVERAGE; a tip truncated at one end would otherwise enter as an extreme divergence in that module

parameters.name: Second-shell outer edge
parameters.description: All-atom distance to IP3 separating the second ligand shell from the third (the first shell is ligand.contact_cutoff).
parameters.source_note: S22's SHELL_EDGES: equal 3.5 A steps out from the 4.5 A contact cutoff

parameters.name: Third-shell outer edge
parameters.description: All-atom distance to IP3 separating the third ligand shell from the fourth.
parameters.source_note: S22's SHELL_EDGES

parameters.name: Ligand-shell search radius
parameters.description: Residues farther than this from IP3 belong to no shell (absent, not an open last bin).
parameters.source_note: S22's SEARCH_RADIUS_A: past 15 A no side chain of the binding core reaches the ligand

parameters.name: Gap-open cost
parameters.description: Cost of opening a gap in the pairwise alignment that carries residue numbers between paralogs.
parameters.source_note: EMBOSS needle's default with BLOSUM62 [henikoff1992]; the recursion is Gotoh's [gotoh1982]

parameters.name: Gap-extend cost
parameters.description: Cost of each further residue of a gap in the paralog-transfer alignment.
parameters.source_note: EMBOSS needle's default

parameters.name: Numbering-check identity
parameters.description: Fraction of residues a structure must share, by number, with a reference sequence to be declared in that reference's numbering.
parameters.source_note: The rule ip3r_genes S24 (D64) applied before painting variants on structures; strict, because an offset still aligns most residues with something

parameters.name: Minimum column occupancy
parameters.description: A conservation score is used only where at least this fraction of (weighted) sequences have a residue in the column.
parameters.source_note: S17's MIN_OCCUPANCY, so re-derived AUCs are computed on the positions S17 scored

parameters.name: Geometry agreement tolerance
parameters.description: Largest difference in a radius, residual or distance that still counts as reproducing the published value.
parameters.source_note: The published values are quoted to 0.01 A; 0.05 A allows for rounding and axis-fit differences and nothing else

parameters.name: Significance level
parameters.description: Level at which a check reads a published or re-derived p (or q) as significant when testing the pattern the prose states.
parameters.source_note: The level ip3r_genes' prose uses throughout

parameters.name: P-value agreement tolerance
parameters.description: Largest difference in log10 of a re-derived and a published p-value that still counts as agreement.
parameters.source_note: Published p-values carry six significant figures, and a normal approximation written independently of scipy's agrees with it to well under 0.01 decades; 0.02 leaves room for rounding only

parameters.name: Statistic agreement tolerance
parameters.description: Largest difference in a re-derived AUC, mean or fraction that still counts as agreement.
parameters.source_note: Published tables round to four decimals; 0.002 allows for rounding and tie-handling differences

parameters.name: SH-aLRT support bar
parameters.description: A tree node counts as supported only if its SH-like approximate likelihood-ratio support is at least this.
parameters.source_note: The IQ-TREE recommendation for SH-aLRT, and half of the joint bar ip3r_genes Paper 2 holds every claim to

parameters.name: UFBoot support bar
parameters.description: A tree node counts as supported only if its ultrafast bootstrap support is at least this.
parameters.source_note: Hoang et al.'s threshold for a clade to be considered real, and the other half of Paper 2's joint bar

parameters.name: Contiguity bar (contig N50)
parameters.description: An assembly counts as able to hold the gene when its contig N50 is at least this; the grid splits genomes above and below it.
parameters.source_note: ip3r_genes D4's bar, fixed before any error rate was known: the median measured genomic span of an ITPR gene (Paper 3, results/methods/contiguity_summary.json d4_bar)

parameters.name: Absence-clade proteome floor
parameters.description: A phylum or class is an absence target when at least this many of its reference proteomes were swept and none carries a call.
parameters.source_note: ip3r_genes S23 manifest rule G3 (results/s23_scope/report.md: 'one per clade S20 swept >= 10 proteomes of and found 0 ITPR in')

parameters.name: Substantial-match E-value
parameters.description: A relaxed-search hit is substantial only at or below this full-sequence E-value (with the coverage bar).
parameters.source_note: ip3r_genes S20's primary threshold, the strict side of its one-search-two-sensitivities design (results/s20_sweep/report.md)

parameters.name: Substantial-match model coverage
parameters.description: A relaxed-search hit is substantial only if it spans at least this fraction of the profile.
parameters.source_note: ip3r_genes S20: 'spanning at least half the model' (results/s20_sweep/report.md, negative-claims table)

parameters.name: Full-length family floor
parameters.description: A plant or fungal record shorter than this is a fragment of a gene, not a full-length receptor.
parameters.source_note: ip3r_genes S20 chase threshold min_length_aa (results/s20_sweep/verdict_summary.json)

parameters.name: Contaminant identity
parameters.description: A record this identical (or more) to one relative outside its kingdom, over the coverage bar, is an assembly-contamination suspect.
parameters.source_note: ip3r_genes S20 chase threshold contaminant_pident (results/s20_sweep/verdict_summary.json)

parameters.name: Contaminant coverage
parameters.description: Query coverage the contaminant identity must hold over.
parameters.source_note: ip3r_genes S20 chase threshold contaminant_qcov (results/s20_sweep/verdict_summary.json)

parameters.description: Amplitude of the falling Hill term of a24.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), the IP3R-1 fit of Siekmann et al. 2012 at 0.1 mM ATP as extended by Cao et al. 2013; read 2026-09-24

parameters.name: a24: IP3 half-constant
parameters.description: IP3 at half of the Hill term of a24.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), the IP3R-1 fit of Siekmann et al. 2012 at 0.1 mM ATP as extended by Cao et al. 2013; read 2026-09-24

parameters.name: a24: IP3 Hill coefficient
parameters.description: Hill coefficient in IP3 of a24.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), the IP3R-1 fit of Siekmann et al. 2012 at 0.1 mM ATP as extended by Cao et al. 2013; read 2026-09-24

parameters.name: Relaxation rate of m24
parameters.description: Rate at which m24 approaches its equilibrium.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), the IP3R-1 fit of Siekmann et al. 2012 at 0.1 mM ATP as extended by Cao et al. 2013; read 2026-09-24

parameters.name: Relaxation rate of h24
parameters.description: Rate at which h24 approaches its equilibrium.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), the IP3R-1 fit of Siekmann et al. 2012 at 0.1 mM ATP as extended by Cao et al. 2013; read 2026-09-24

parameters.name: Relaxation rate of m42
parameters.description: Rate at which m42 approaches its equilibrium.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), the IP3R-1 fit of Siekmann et al. 2012 at 0.1 mM ATP as extended by Cao et al. 2013; read 2026-09-24

parameters.name: Recovery rate of h42 (channel closed)
parameters.description: Rate of h42 while the channel is closed: the slow recovery from Ca2+ inhibition that Cao et al. 2013 found necessary for realistic inter-puff intervals.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), the IP3R-1 fit of Siekmann et al. 2012 at 0.1 mM ATP as extended by Cao et al. 2013; read 2026-09-24. Cao 2013 treats it as a free parameter (a_h42, 1 s^-1 in its Fig. 2); 0.5 is the value in the 2014 code

parameters.name: Inhibition rate of h42 (channel open)
parameters.description: Rate of h42 while the channel is open: fast inhibition by the Ca2+ at its own mouth.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), the IP3R-1 fit of Siekmann et al. 2012 at 0.1 mM ATP as extended by Cao et al. 2013; read 2026-09-24. Cao 2013 Eq. 10 writes it as a steep Ca2+ switch at 20 uM with V_h42 = 100 s^-1; the 2014 code switches on the open state with 20 s^-1, which is used here

parameters.name: Ca2+ at an open channel's mouth
parameters.description: Added to the cluster Ca2+ seen by an open receptor (its own nanodomain), after Rudiger's two-concentration puff model as used by Cao et al. 2013 (c_m = c + c_h).
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), the IP3R-1 fit of Siekmann et al. 2012 at 0.1 mM ATP as extended by Cao et al. 2013; read 2026-09-24: 120 uM x (store Ca2+ / 100 uM); the store is held full here, so 120 uM

parameters.name: Park/drive cluster time step
parameters.description: Step of the park/drive cluster simulation. The constant-rate transitions inside each mode are taken exactly over a step (matrix exponential); the Ca2+-dependent mode switches and the gating variables are updated once per step.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2013: 'We choose a maximum time step size of 10^-4 s'

parameters.name: Cluster Ca2+ per open channel (park/drive)
parameters.description: Mean-field cluster Ca2+ increment per open channel for the park/drive cluster; the same coupling scheme as puff.ca_per_open.
parameters.source_note: Chosen by the rule used for puff.ca_per_open: the coupling (0-0.5 uM at 0.1-0.5 uM IP3) that most raises the Fano factor; it peaks at 0.1-0.2 (Fano 2.7-3.6). Cao et al. 2014's own microdomain gives about 0.11 uM per open channel (k_IPR x store Ca2+ / k_diff)

parameters.name: Observation bin
parameters.description: Both cluster simulators record, per bin, the number open at the bin's start (for the Fano factor) and the most open at once within it (for events).
parameters.source_note: Of the order of the frame time of fast puff imaging (Smith & Parker 2009 record at ~2 ms); it resolves the fast park-mode flickers (0.3 ms) as brief one-channel events rather than missing them

parameters.name: Large-event fraction of the cluster
parameters.description: An event whose peak reaches this fraction of the cluster counts as recruiting the cluster (a puff); the recruitment share is the fraction of multi-channel events that do.
parameters.source_note: Half the cluster: independent coincidences essentially never reach it (DYK uncoupled peaks at 6 of 20), while an all-or-none release should

parameters.name: Smallest non-zero coupling in the scan
parameters.description: The coupling scan runs 0 and then geometrically from this to puff.scan_max.
parameters.source_note: The step of the scan that chose puff.ca_per_open

parameters.name: Largest coupling in the scan
parameters.description: Top of the coupling scan.
parameters.source_note: The top of the scan that chose puff.ca_per_open

parameters.name: Non-zero couplings in the scan
parameters.description: Number of geometric steps from puff.scan_min to puff.scan_max.
parameters.source_note: About two points per factor of two over 0.05-2 uM

parameters.name: Temperature
parameters.description: Absolute temperature in the thermal voltage and the Nernst-Einstein conductivity.
parameters.source_note: Vais et al. 2010 (PMC2995152), Results: 'symmetric 140-mM KCl solutions ([K+]f = [Cl-]f ~ 104 mM) in the absence of Mg2+'; 'current traces were acquired at room temperature'; 23 C taken for room temperature

parameters.name: Bath KCl concentration
parameters.description: Symmetric bath salt. The nominal concentration, not the ~104 mM free (activity) value the paper also gives; the model has no activity coefficients.
parameters.source_note: Vais et al. 2010 (PMC2995152), Results: 'symmetric 140-mM KCl solutions ([K+]f = [Cl-]f ~ 104 mM) in the absence of Mg2+'; 'current traces were acquired at room temperature'

parameters.name: Test voltage
parameters.description: Voltage at which the chord conductance is evaluated.
parameters.source_note: Inside Vais 2010's -25 to +15 mV ramp, where their I-V is linear, so chord equals slope conductance

parameters.name: K+ bulk diffusivity
parameters.description: Bulk diffusion coefficient of K+.
parameters.source_note: K+ in water at 25 C; the standard tabulated value (as PIEZO1)

parameters.name: Cl- bulk diffusivity
parameters.description: Bulk diffusion coefficient of Cl-.
parameters.source_note: Cl- in water at 25 C; the standard tabulated value (as PIEZO1)

parameters.name: K+ crystal radius
parameters.description: Subtracted from the free radius to give the area a K+ centre can occupy.
parameters.source_note: Shannon radius. Crystal rather than hydrated, because an ion can shed water at a constriction - itself a modelling choice (as PIEZO1)

parameters.name: Cl- crystal radius
parameters.description: Subtracted from the free radius for Cl-.
parameters.source_note: Shannon radius

parameters.name: In-pore diffusivity fraction
parameters.description: In-pore diffusivity as a fraction of bulk, for both species.
parameters.source_note: Not measured for any IP3R. PIEZO1's value, kept so the two projects are comparable; with the ion radius it is what the answer is most sensitive to, so it is swept (permeation.sweep_*), never tuned

parameters.name: In-pore relative permittivity
parameters.description: Enters only the reported Debye length.
parameters.source_note: Nanopore water is less polarisable than bulk (80); 40 is a common compromise (as PIEZO1)

parameters.name: Sweep: lowest diffusivity fraction
parameters.description: Low end of the in-pore diffusivity sweep.
parameters.source_note: PIEZO1's plausible range, 0.25-1.0 of bulk

parameters.name: Sweep: highest diffusivity fraction
parameters.description: High end of the in-pore diffusivity sweep (bulk water).
parameters.source_note: PIEZO1's plausible range

parameters.name: Sweep: smallest ion radius
parameters.description: Low end of the ion-radius sweep.
parameters.source_note: PIEZO1's plausible range, 1.0-2.0 A

parameters.name: Sweep: largest ion radius
parameters.description: High end of the ion-radius sweep.
parameters.source_note: PIEZO1's plausible range

parameters.name: ITPR3 conductance (DT40)
parameters.description: Rat InsP3R-3 in the outer nuclear membrane of DT40-KO cells, symmetric 140 mM KCl.

parameters.name: ITPR3 conductance (oocyte)
parameters.description: Rat InsP3R-3 in the Xenopus oocyte outer nuclear membrane, symmetric KCl, 0 Mg2+.
parameters.source_note: Mak 2000 (PMC2217211): 'the InsP3R-3 I-V relation became linear with a conductance of 358 +/- 8 pS'. Vais 2010 cites this paper as 370 +/- 8 pS; the primary text is used

parameters.name: Charge lining margin
parameters.description: A charge centre lines the pore when it is at most this far outside the profile's atom-centre radius at its own height.
parameters.source_note: About one water diameter (2.8 A): a charge one hydration layer behind the lumen wall still acts on the ions in it. Swept in SESSION_LOG, not tuned

parameters.name: Stubbed side-chain reach
parameters.description: A stubbed ionisable residue is counted as unplaced when its C-alpha is within this plus the lining margin of the lumen.
parameters.source_note: C-alpha to guanidinium centre of an extended Arg, the longest ionisable side chain (PIEZO1's pore_charge.reach_arg)

parameters.name: Axial charge smoothing
parameters.description: Gaussian width each charge is spread over along the axis.
parameters.source_note: About a side chain's positional uncertainty at 3 A resolution; the total charge is conserved whatever it is (as PIEZO1)

parameters.name: Counterion packing ceiling
parameters.description: In-pore concentration above which a result is flagged; nothing is clipped to it.
parameters.source_note: Close-packed hydrated K+ is about 8 M, so 10 M is where a continuum of point ions has certainly stopped describing a solution (as PIEZO1)
